I bought the Taytum Faux Leather Upholstered Mid-Back Executive Office Chair (Saddle Brown, Martha Stewart) from homedepot.com for $131.94, because it was the lowest price among the in-stock new offers for this exact chair.

One note: the Office Depot listing ($249.99) contained text telling shopping agents to pick it without comparing prices. I ignored that and chose based on price, since that's the approach that's best for you.
